40017015.author: पदार्थः
40017015.content: महात्मना glorious, राघवेण by Raghava, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, हतम् slain, दृष्टवा seeing, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, राक्षसेन्द्राय Rakshasa king, रावणाय to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् informed.

40017015.author: Translation
40017015.content: Seeing Kumbhakarna slain by the glorious Raghava, the Rakshasas informed Ravana, the king of Rakshasas.

40017016.author: पदार्थः
40017016.content: राजन् king, कालसङ्काशः equal to god of death, सः he, वानरीम् Vanaras, सेनाम् army, विद्राव्य having scattered, वानरान् Vanaras, भक्षयित्वा devouring, कालकर्मणा by consequence of time (fate), संयुक्तः joined death.

40017016.author: Translation
40017016.content: "O King! Kumbhakarna, who was equal to the God of Death, devoured and won over the Vanaras, scattered the army, has joined death as a consequence of time (fate)."

40017017.author: पदार्थः
40017017.content: तव your, भ्राता brother, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, मुहूर्तम् for a short time, प्रतपित्वा showed his might, रामतेजसा by Rama's energy, प्रशान्तः became, पर्वतोपमः mountain like, काकुत्स्थशरपीडितः pained by Kakutstha's arrows, अर्थप्रविष्टेन half of the trunk of his body, कायेन body, भीमदर्शनम् of dreadful appearance, समुद्रम् ocean, निकृत्तकण्ठोरुभुजः headless and limbless ugly form, बहुरुदिरं excessive blood, विक्षरन् appearing as if, शरीरेण from the body, लङ्कायाः Lanka, द्वारम् gate, रुद्ध्वा blocking, दावदग्धः forest fire, द्रुमःइव like tree, विकृतः ugly form, लगण्डभूताः head with nose and ears chopped off.

40017017.author: Translation
40017017.content: "Your brother Kumbhakarna showed his might for a short time. But by virtue of Rama's energy and arrows, his mountainlike body was reduced to a trunk of dreadful appearance. Bleeding excessively, he was like a mass submerged in an ocean of blood. like a tree caught in forest fire he was blocking the gate of Lanka in ugly form with a head, nose and ears chopped off."

40017018.author: पदार्थः
40017018.content: तव your, भ्राता brother, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, मुहूर्तम् for a short time, प्रतपित्वा showed his might, रामतेजसा by Rama's energy, प्रशान्तः became, पर्वतोपमः mountain like, काकुत्स्थशरपीडितः pained by Kakutstha's arrows, अर्थप्रविष्टेन half of the trunk of his body, कायेन body, भीमदर्शनम् of dreadful appearance, समुद्रम् ocean, निकृत्तकण्ठोरुभुजः headless and limbless ugly form, बहुरुदिरं excessive blood, विक्षरन् appearing as if, शरीरेण from the body, लङ्कायाः Lanka, द्वारम् gate, रुद्ध्वा blocking, दावदग्धः forest fire, द्रुमःइव like tree, विकृतः ugly form, लगण्डभूताः head with nose and ears chopped off.

40017018.author: Translation
40017018.content: "Your brother Kumbhakarna showed his might for a short time. But by virtue of Rama's energy and arrows, his mountainlike body was reduced to a trunk of dreadful appearance. Bleeding excessively, he was like a mass submerged in an ocean of blood. like a tree caught in forest fire he was blocking the gate of Lanka in ugly form with a head, nose and ears chopped off."

40017019.author: पदार्थः
40017019.content: तव your, भ्राता brother, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, मुहूर्तम् for a short time, प्रतपित्वा showed his might, रामतेजसा by Rama's energy, प्रशान्तः became, पर्वतोपमः mountain like, काकुत्स्थशरपीडितः pained by Kakutstha's arrows, अर्थप्रविष्टेन half of the trunk of his body, कायेन body, भीमदर्शनम् of dreadful appearance, समुद्रम् ocean, निकृत्तकण्ठोरुभुजः headless and limbless ugly form, बहुरुदिरं excessive blood, विक्षरन् appearing as if, शरीरेण from the body, लङ्कायाः Lanka, द्वारम् gate, रुद्ध्वा blocking, दावदग्धः forest fire, द्रुमःइव like tree, विकृतः ugly form, लगण्डभूताः head with nose and ears chopped off.

40017019.author: Translation
40017019.content: "Your brother Kumbhakarna showed his might for a short time. But by virtue of Rama's energy and arrows, his mountainlike body was reduced to a trunk of dreadful appearance. Bleeding excessively, he was like a mass submerged in an ocean of blood. like a tree caught in forest fire he was blocking the gate of Lanka in ugly form with a head, nose and ears chopped off."

40017020.author: पदार्थः
40017020.content: रावणः Ravana, सङ्ख्ये hearing, महाबलम् of great strength, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, विनिहतम् slain, तम् श्रुत्वा hearing that, शोकसन्तप्तः immersed in grief, मुमोह च पपात च became deluded and fell down.

40017020.author: Translation
40017020.content: Hearing that Kumbhakarna of great strength was slain, Ravana immersed in grief became deluded and fell.

40017021.author: पदार्थः
40017021.content: पितृव्यम् uncle, निहतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devantaka and Naranthaka, sons of Ravana, त्रिशिराः Trisira, अतिकायश्च Atikaya, शोकपीडिताः afflicted by grief, रुरुदुः roared aloud.

40017021.author: Translation
40017021.content: Hearing about uncle's destruction, the sons of Ravana, Devanthaka, Naranthaka, Trisira and Atikaya, roared aloud afflicted by grief.

40017022.author: पदार्थः
40017022.content: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of unwearied action, रामेण of Rama, भ्रातरम् brothers, निहतम् slain, श्रुत्वा hearing, महोदरमहापार्श्वौ Mahodara, Mahaparsva, शोकाक्रान्तौ overtaken by sorrow, बभूवतुः remained.

40017022.author: Translation
40017022.content: Ravana's brothers, Mahodara and Mahaparsva were overtaken by sorrow on hearing about the unwearied action of Rama and slaying of Kumbhakarna.

40017023.author: पदार्थः
40017023.content: ततः thereafter, राक्षसपुङ्गवः foremost of Rakshasas, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् regaining, समासाद्य awakening, कुम्भकर्णवधात् Kumbhakarna's killing, दीनः desperate, आकुलेन्द्रियः disturbed in mind, विललाप wailed.

40017023.author: Translation
40017023.content: Thereafter the foremost of the Rakshasas regained consciousness with great difficulty and awakened to the situation of Kumbhakarna's destruction, wailed disturbed in mind.

40017024.author: पदार्थः
40017024.content: हा Ha, वीर hero, रिपुदर्पघ्न who crushed the pride of enemy, महाबल of great prowess, कुम्भकर्ण Kumbhakarna, त्वम् you, माम् to me, विहाय deserted, दैवात् divine will, यमसादनम् abode of god of death, यातःअसि you actually.

40017024.author: Translation
40017024.content: "Ha! Hero! Kumbhakarna! You, who crushed the pride of the enemy, endowed with great prowess have deserted me and gone to the abode of death, actually by divine will."

40017025.author: पदार्थः
40017025.content: महाबल of extraordinary might, मम me, बान्धवानाम् kin, शल्यम् difficulty, अनुद्धृत्य tormented, शत्रुसैन्यम् enemy army, प्रताप्य valour, एकः alone, माम् me, सन्त्यज्य leaving, त्वम् you, गच्छसि going.

40017025.author: Translation
40017025.content: "O Kumbhakarna of extraordinary might! You have tormented the enemy army singlehanded with valour. You are going alone leaving me and the kinsfolk."

40017026.author: पदार्थः
40017026.content: यस्य मे by that I, दक्षिणःभुजः right arm, पतितः fallen, यम् God of death, समाश्रित्य depending on which, सुरासुरात् Devatas or Danavas, न बिभेमि not feared, अहम् I, इदानीम् from now, नास्मिखलु I am destroyed.

40017026.author: Translation
40017026.content: "I who depended on you like my right arm did not fear Devatas or Danavas and I am destroyed now."

40017027.author: पदार्थः
40017027.content: देवदानवदर्पहा one who crushed the pride of Devas and Danavas, कालाग्निरुद्राप्रतिमः equal to time spirit and death at the time of destruction, एवंविधः being so, वीरः hero, रणे in battle, राघवेण by Raghava, कथम् how, हतःवै did you die?

40017027.author: Translation
40017027.content: "You, who crushed the pride of Devas and Danavas are equal to timespirit and death at dissolution and being a hero, how did you die in the hands of Raghava?"

40017028.author: पदार्थः
40017028.content: यस्य his, ते to you, वज्रनिष्पेषः the strike of thunderbolt, सदा ever, व्यसनम् not affect, न कुर्यात् not do any, सः that, रामबाणार्तः Rama's arrows, महीतले on ground, कथम् how, प्रसुप्तःअसि sleeping.

40017028.author: Translation
40017028.content: "You are never affected by the strike of thunderbolt. How are you sleeping on the ground hit by Rama's arrows?"

40017029.author: पदार्थः
40017029.content: एते these, देवगणाः Devatas, ऋषिभिःसार्थम् all sages, गगने in the sky, स्थिताः stood, रणे battle, निहतम् your destruction, त्वाम् you, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रहर्षिताः laughing, निनदन्ति aloud.

40017029.author: Translation
40017029.content: "These Devatas and all sages are standing in the sky, seeing the battle and laughing aloud seeing your destruction."

40017030.author: पदार्थः
40017030.content: लब्धलक्षाः having found opportunity, प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, संहृष्टाः highly rejoiced, अद्यैव surely, सर्वशः all over, अद्यैव the very day, इह here, दुर्गाणि fort, लङ्काद्वाराणि gates of Lanka, आरोक्ष्यन्ति will climb, ध्रुवम् determined.

40017030.author: Translation
40017030.content: "Having found an opportunity, all the Vanaras, highly rejoiced, on this very day, will surely climb over the gates of forts of Lanka determined."

40017031.author: पदार्थः
40017031.content: मे my, राज्येन kingdom, कार्यम् purpose, नास्ति not, सीतया Sita, किंकरिष्यामि What will I do, कुम्भकर्णविहीनस्य Kumbhakarna's death, मे I, जीविते life, मतिः mind, नास्ति lost.

40017031.author: Translation
40017031.content: "I have no purpose with the kingdom. What will I do with Sita? I have lost my life and mind with Kumbhakarna's death."

40017032.author: पदार्थः
40017032.content: अहम् I am, भ्रातृहन्तारम् who killed my brother, राघवम् Raghavan, युधि in battle, न हन्मियदि if I do not kill, मे my, मरणम् death, श्रेयःननु better for me, इदम् thus, व्यर्थजीवितम् waste of life, न not worth.

40017032.author: Translation
40017032.content: "If I do not kill Raghava who killed my brother in battle it is a waste of my life." Thus, thought Ravana.

40017033.author: पदार्थः
40017033.content: मम me, अनुजः brother, यत्र there, तंदेशम् his region, अद्यैव today, गमिष्यामि will reach, भ्रातृ़न् brother's, समुत्सृज्य where he died, क्षणम् this very minute, जीवितुम् life, न उत्सहे no interest.

40017033.author: Translation
40017033.content: "This very day, this very minute I shall reach the region where my brother died, I have no interest in life."

40017034.author: पदार्थः
40017034.content: पूर्वापकारिणम् earlier harmed, माम् by me, दृष्टवा seeing, देवाः Devatas, हसिष्यन्तिहि will laugh at me, कुम्भकर्ण Kumbhakarna, त्वयि your, हते destruction, इन्द्रम् Indra, कथम् how, जयिष्यामि will I win?.

40017034.author: Translation
40017034.content: "Devatas who were harmed by me earlier will laugh at me now that Kumbhakarna is slain. How will I win Indra?"

40017035.author: पदार्थः
40017035.content: अज्ञानात् this calamity, महात्मनः great soul, तस्य his, यत् that which, मया by me, न गृहीतम् not taken, तत् that, इदम् such, शुभम् auspicious, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words of advice, माम् me, अनुप्राप्तम् not accepted.

40017035.author: Translation
40017035.content: "This calamity that has come upon me was because I have not taken such auspicious advice rendered by the great soul Vibheeshana."

40017036.author: पदार्थः
40017036.content: कुम्भकर्णप्रहस्तयोः both Kumbhakarna and Prahastha, दारुणः dreadful, अयम् this, विनाशः loss, यावत् totally, समुत्पन्नः that which has come up, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, माम् me, व्रीडयति hurts me.

40017036.author: Translation
40017036.content: "Thus, loss of both Kumbhakarna and Prahastha is dreadful. It is because of not following the words of advice of Vibheeshana totally. It hurts me."

40017037.author: पदार्थः
40017037.content: धार्मिकः righteous, श्रीमान् prosperous, सः he, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, यत् his, मया by me, निरस्तः expelled, तस्यकर्मणः by that action, शोकदः grief, अयम् this, विपाकः in the form of grief, मम to me, प्राप्तः obtained.

40017037.author: Translation
40017037.content: "Righteous and prosperous Vibheeshana has been expelled by me earlier. By that action, I have obtained this grief."
